people.imagined: At the forge at the close of the day, wiping his hands on a rag and lifting the left one to look at the stubs of his missing fingers, as he does when the war comes up at the long table. He is about to say it again.
people.subject: The moment: at the close of a forge day a master smith holds up his LEFT hand toward the viewer, palm out, to show it: the last two fingers (ring and little finger) are missing, only smooth stumps remain, and the three left fingers are spread. Face: a square, heavy, soot-darkened face; deep lines; small steady grey eyes; heavy straight brows singed short; a flat nose; a thick moustache; a stubborn, patient, closed mouth. Hair: short grey-black, cropped close, held by a band of folded sand-gold silk round the forehead. Body: broad and thick through chest and shoulders, huge forearms, a short neck. Clothing: long layered robes of sand-gold silk over dark-brown silk, two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and tiny caravan stars, the wide sleeves tied back with silk cords above the elbow and the forearms wrapped in silk-bound vambraces; a hooded sand-gold over-robe slipped off one shoulder; a small horn whistle on a cord. Power: a heavy ochre-gold glow of earth qi gathers at the hammer, with a few drifting motes. Hands and objects: the raised left hand with its missing fingers is the focus; his right hand rests a long iron striker's hammer on his shoulder. A well-made narrow straight sword of his own forging, its grip bound in sand-brown leather with the thumb-groove cut deeper on the left for his shortened hand, a squared dark-iron guard stamped with a small hammer-mark, a scabbard of dark-brown cowhide stitched with sinew and scorched at the throat, is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the left shoulder. Background: a dark forge hall dissolving into mist, a glow of coals, a bellows. Light: red-orange firelight from the lower left, a soft ochre spirit-glow and a faint rim light on his shoulder. Expression: a tired, stubborn face with deep lines about the eyes and a heavy, resolved mouth just opening to speak.

people.imagined: On a stone stair in the evening, counting steps under his breath, his lips moving. He is also counting the people on the stair behind him, and he is not sure how many he is missing.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a stone stair he looks back over his shoulder at the viewer with his lips moving as if counting, one forefinger lifted and tapping the air. Face: a lean, careful, tan face with a long jaw; pale grey eyes slightly narrowed; fine level brows; a long straight nose; thin lips shaped around a silent count; a few early lines at the eyes. Hair: dark brown, tied back at the nape in a tight tail with a thin gold-brown ribbon, neat. Body: tall, lean, upright, a lieutenant's tidy bearing. Clothing: a long hooded robe of sand-gold silk, clean and beautifully hung, pinned at the right shoulder with a small jade clasp so the sabre hilt shows at the left hip; under it dark-brown silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars; silk-wrapped vambraces; a flat dark-gold sash with a jade pendant; a small bone whistle on a cord at his collar. Power: a thin haze of ochre earth-qi motes drifts about his shoulders. Hands and objects: the forefinger of the right hand raised mid-count; the left hand rests on the grip of a sheathed sabre. Background: sandstone steps climbing into blue mist, a single lamp lit in an arch, faint motes of light. Light: cool moonlit blue from the upper left, a touch of warm lamp glow at his cheek, a soft rim light along the hood. Expression: cautious, honest and quietly uncertain; the look of a man who has chosen the easy name before.

people.imagined: At the forge, arms aching from the bellows, she has just been told again that she may not do the quench. She swipes sweat off her face and demands the next strike, glaring at the apprentice.
people.subject: The moment: at a forge she grips the long bellows handle with both hands, leaning back on it, chin out, glaring at someone off to the right. Face (most important: the eyebrows): a round, flushed, soot-streaked young face; there are NO real eyebrows, only a band of short dark stubble where they were shaved, and the left stubble line is nicked with a notch that tilts it into a permanent question; bright, hard, dark eyes; a short nose; a stubborn pressed mouth. Sweat cuts clean lines through the soot at her temples. Hair: black, in a thick single braid wound round the head and held with a sand-gold silk ribbon. Body: short, sturdy, strong arms with visible muscle, bent forward. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of the hall: a plain sand-gold robe over a dark-brown under-robe with two crossed collars lightly embroidered with dunes, wide sleeves tied back past the elbow with cords, scorched silk-wrapped wrist wraps, a short smith's apron of dark cloth tied over the front; a small horn whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: both hands on a long wooden bellows handle polished dark by years of hands; a pair of tongs hangs at her belt. A small ring of orange glows at her knuckles. Background: a forge hall dissolving into drifting smoke and mist, a white-hot glow, hanging tools. Light: fierce orange firelight from the front left, a hint of ember motes at her cheek and a thin rim light on the braid. Expression: an impatient, jut-chinned glare with the brows' question mark cocked, a girl who has been told no again and means to be told yes.

people.imagined: Night watch on the Đà Linh road. A rider passes on the far side and he does not turn his head, although his eyes follow her. His nose has been broken twice and set once.
people.subject: The moment: on a night road by a small fire, he keeps his head dead straight but slides his eyes to the right as if watching a passer-by he refuses to acknowledge. Face (most important: the nose): a hard young face, weathered; his nose is clearly broken, bent sharply to the left with a bump on the bridge and a second kink below it, the crooked nose dominating the face; dark flat eyes; heavy brows; a firm hard mouth; a faint scar across one cheek. Hair: black, short, roughly shorn, with a night-watch band of dark-gold silk tied round the head. Body: stocky, broad, standing square. Clothing: a hooded robe of sand-gold silk thrown back from the head, over dark-brown quilted silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars; silk-wrapped vambraces; a dark sash with a small jade charm; a sabre on the left hip; a horn whistle on a cord. Power: a faint ochre haze of earth qi gathers at his shoulders. Hands and objects: his left hand holds a short iron lantern shuttered to a slit of light; his right rests on the sabre pommel. Background: a dark desert road in drifting mist, the silhouette of a camel, a sky of cold stars. Light: low orange firelight from the lower right, cold moonlit starlight from the upper left and a thin silvery rim light. Expression: a stone-set face with a rigid jaw, the head dead straight and only the eyes sliding sideways.

people.imagined: In the watch-house at dawn she sits with the watch book open and chews a pen end, a fresh one tucked behind each ear. She is deciding, on a whim, whose name to strike. She has already decided.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk at dawn she looks up suddenly from a ledger with a pen between her teeth, eyes sharp and suspicious. Face (most important: the pens): a sharp, narrow, sallow face; wary dark eyes with dark shadows beneath; thin straight brows; a small nose; her mouth clamped on a chewed pen end; at least three chewed pen-ends are tucked behind EACH ear, standing out like quills, clearly visible. Her lower lip is stained faintly blue from the pen. Hair: black, short and uneven, cut with a knife, pushed behind both ears. Body: thin, angular, hunched over the desk. Clothing: a sand-gold silk over-robe thrown loosely over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes, wide sleeves with ink-stained cuffs; silk-wrapped vambraces; a horn whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: a thick open book showing only horizontal rows of dots and hoofprint sketches, no letters; her right hand clutches a brush hovering over it; a hoofprint cast in plaster on the desk. Past the right shoulder rises the tan-corded hilt of a plain long straight sword slung on the back, its ochre-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of plain grey steel. Background: a watch-house wall fading into pale mist, a window with grey dawn, a small brass lamp burning out on the sill. Light: cold silvery dawn from the upper left, a thin rim light on her cheek and a faint ochre glimmer of earth qi motes over the page. Expression: a sharp, narrow, suspicious stare with the mouth clamped on the pen, a foundling who trusts nobody's tea and has already struck a name.

people.imagined: In the long hall with a feather duster at the cup shelf, he has stopped on the eleventh recent cup and is turning it in his hands, frowning, as the thought has just landed.
people.subject: The moment: in a long hall he stands on a stool before a high shelf lined with rows of pale glass and jade cups, holding one cup up to the light in both hands, frowning. Face: a pleasant, open, round young face; wide-set honest brown eyes with a crease between the brows; a pale, earnest mouth slightly open; a small nose; a little fuzz on the lip; a scatter of freckles across his nose. Hair: black, short, flopping onto the forehead. Body: slender, a bit gangly, tall on the stool. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk: a clean sand-gold over-robe folded back off the shoulders so it does not brush the shelf, over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars lightly embroidered with dunes; the wide sleeves tied back with cords. Hands and objects: the fingertips of both hands are visibly wax-yellow; one night-glowing cup of pale green glass held up and glowing faintly; a feather duster tucked in his belt; behind him, rows of identical small cups. Background: shelves of many small cups rising into shadow and soft mist, a long table, drifting motes. Light: warm hall light from the upper left and a soft green spirit-glow from the cup, which falls across his chin and fingers; a thin rim light on his hair. Expression: an earnest, open, slightly puzzled frown, lips parted, the look of a trusting boy who has just begun to doubt something small and very important.

people.imagined: The end of the evening in the long hall kitchen. She sets down one extra bowl, at an empty seat, as she does every night, and no one has told her to. Her palms are white with old salt scars.
people.subject: The moment: in a long hall by lamplight she sets a bowl of steaming food at an empty place at the table and turns her open palms up toward the viewer, as if showing she has nothing more to give. Face: a soft, round, kind face; large, gentle brown eyes; thick soft brows; a small nose; a calm, shy smile; flushed cheeks. Hair: black, in a long braid pinned up in a loop, a scrap of white gauze tied over it; a few loose curls stick to her damp temples. Body: short and sturdy, round shoulders, a cook's strong forearms; she stands with feet together and elbows tucked. Clothing: a mortal servant's plain but clean dress, kept graceful: a sand-gold silk shawl over a plain dark-brown robe with a crossed collar, and an apron of undyed cotton, sleeves rolled. Both palms, held up, are covered with pale white scars like cracked salt, crisscrossing, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a steaming bowl of rice and mutton beside an empty chair with no one at it; a ladle. Background: a long hall of benches and hanging lamps dissolving into soft mist. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, steam catching the light in a faint glow, a lamp flame reflected in the dark of her eyes, a gentle rim light on her cheek. Expression: a soft, quiet, devout face with gentle lowered eyes and a calm, tender mouth.

people.imagined: In the long hall, seated with her back to the wall, as in every room. Above her head the shelf of 312 cups glimmers. She has just counted the doors again and her eyes settle on the one the viewer comes through.
people.subject: The moment: she sits with her back against a pale stone wall, a sabre across her knees, and her eyes have just turned to the doorway where the viewer enters. Face: a square, strong, sun-darkened face, like tanned leather; broad cheekbones; hard black eyes with fine lines round them; level strong brows; a straight nose; a thin, firm mouth; a faint scar at the left jaw. Hair: black with a few grey threads, pulled back and pinned in a tight low knot with a plain gold-brown hairpin. Body: square and compact, broad shoulders, the posture of someone who sits with a wall at her back. Clothing: a long hooded robe of fine sand-gold silk, clean and sharply hung, over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars; silk-wrapped vambraces; a dark-gold sash with a jade pendant; a horn whistle on a cord; she is a founder and head of the hall, so her robes are the richest of the sheet: a dark-gold gauze over-robe with wide sleeves and a gold headpiece. Power: a visible ochre-gold aura of earth qi stirs about her, with floating motes of gold light. Hands and objects: across her knees a broad sabre with a grey horn hilt in a plain dark sheath; her left hand rests on a small round shield faced with dull iron leaning at her side. Background: above and behind her, a blurred shelf packed with rows of small pale cups gleaming in rising mist. Light: warm low hall light from the upper left, spirit-glow from her aura and a soft rim light. Expression: a watchful, narrowed gaze with a tight, still mouth and a steady fixed stare on the viewer, tensed for the door.

people.imagined: Spring quenching day at Tẩy Kiếm Tuyền. A blade is in the water and he is entirely silent. His hand is on the hammer and his eyes on the steam. He is thinking that it is one blade shy of finished.
people.subject: The moment: at a forge trough he stands with a hammer on his shoulder and one hand on the edge of a steaming water trough, eyes fixed on the rising steam, utterly silent. Face (most important: no eyebrows): a short, round-faced old man; his brow is completely bare and smooth with NO eyebrows at all, only pink shiny skin above the eyes; deep-set small black eyes; a flat wide nose; heavily wrinkled burn-speckled skin with many small pale burn spots across the cheeks and forehead; a grim, closed mouth. Hair: a bald crown with a ring of white stubble. Body: short, thick, stooped; forearms as thick as temple bells, covered in burn marks. Clothing: an elder's richest robes: layered dark-gold gauze and sand-gold brocade over dark-brown silk, three crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars in gold thread, wide sleeves cut and tied at the elbow over silk-bound vambraces, a short dark apron of scorched silk, a gold headpiece set low on the bald crown; no cloak. Power: a faint steel-grey aura of metal qi shivers around him, with pale silver motes rising in the steam. Hands and objects: a square iron hammer with a face worn mirror-smooth on his shoulder; his other hand on a stone trough, steam rising from a blade just visible under the water. Background: a stone forge hall dissolving in white steam and mist, a stream of spring water. Light: white steam glow and orange coal-light from the lower left, silver spirit-light along the blade and a soft rim light. Expression: a silent, rigid face with lowered brows and eyes fixed on the steam, the jaw set and the mouth tight.

people.imagined: On the Hồi Lan road at the head of a halted caravan, one hand lifted to the drivers to stand easy, the sabre still sheathed. He is thinking of his wife's hair and of one day walking the road unarmed.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a caravan halt, he lifts one big open hand to calm unseen drivers, looking toward the viewer with slow, patient eyes. Face: a big, broad, gentle-looking face; sun-tanned; a heavy square jaw with a short salt-and-pepper beard; slow warm brown eyes; thick brows; a large straight nose; a quiet half smile. Hair: black with grey, tied in a plain low knot bound with a cord of undyed leather, a lock of grey falling over his left temple. Body: very big, broad, tall, thick-armed, the stance of a calm giant, weight set back on his heels, shoulders loose and unhurried. Clothing: a long hooded robe of sand-gold silk, clean, with a high collar turned back, over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars in gold thread; silk-wrapped vambraces; a flat iron-grey sash with a jade pendant; a deputy's richer touch of dark-gold gauze at the sleeves. Power: a calm ochre-gold glow of earth qi at his shoulders, with slow floating motes. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, palm open; at his left hip a sabre in a plain sheath, its grip NOT touched; on his back a large round shield faced with grey iron; a bone whistle at the chest. Background: caravan wagons and camels fading into a pale, misty road. Light: soft golden sun from the upper left, flaring through a haze of fine yellow dust raised by the camels and making a pale gold edge on his beard. Expression: a slow, patient gaze with a calm, gentle smile that carries a trace of sadness at the eyes.

people.imagined: Night camp at a lamp's distance from Ô Liệt Phong's escort. She sits alone beside her one lamp with the book on her knee, and has just been given a cup of tea. She is deciding whether to drink it, and then does.
people.subject: The moment: alone at night beside a single lamp, she holds a small steaming tea cup in both hands, looking over its rim into the dark with measured eyes. Face: a thin, narrow, weathered face; high cheekbones; deep-set dark eyes, shadowed; fine straight grey-streaked brows; a long thin nose; thin lips pressed in thought; fine lines like cracked clay, sunken temples and the dry lines of old pottery. Hair: iron-grey, drawn back flat in a tight bun with a bone pin. Body: very thin, wiry, straight-backed. Clothing: a sand-gold silk robe, worn clean, wrapped round her shoulders over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars; a dark-gold gauze over-robe with wide sleeves; a plain bone whistle on a cord. Power: a pale steel-grey haze of metal qi hangs about her, with a few silver motes drifting in the lamp's light. Hands and objects: a lit brass lamp with a small round shade at her feet; a steaming cup in her long, bony fingers; on her lap TWO books side by side, one thick and worn, one thin and new, covers plain. A well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in ochre silk gone grey with lamp soot, a slim crescent guard of dark iron, a scabbard of dun camel-hide, and a small camel-bell muffled with wool and tied at the scabbard mouth so that it never rings, is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: a night desert in drifting mist, a distant dot of another campfire. Light: warm yellow lamplight from below, cold moonlit blue above, a silver rim light. Expression: a measured, weighing look over the cup's rim, the face of a woman who has kept her own counsel for seventy years and is deciding whether to trust a cup of tea.

people.imagined: At the anvil during a pause, he flicks a copper coin and grins at a younger striker, ready to sell him a turn at the big hammer, his black thumbnail catching the light.
people.subject: The moment: at an anvil he holds out his left hand flat toward the viewer with a copper coin held between two fingers and a greedy grin, thumb prominent. Face: a big, broad, ruddy, cheerful face; a thick black moustache; bright small brown eyes; thick brows; a big nose; a wide grin showing a gold-capped tooth. Sweat runs down both temples into the moustache and soot has left a black mask round the eyes. Hair: black, short and bristly, with a red silk sweatband dark with sweat, a few damp black locks escaping. Body: huge, barrel-chested, big shoulders. Clothing: sleeveless layered dark-brown silk with two crossed collars lightly embroidered with dunes, bare muscled arms in silk-bound vambraces, a short scorched smith's apron of dark cloth, a sand-gold silk cloak hung over one shoulder. Power: a faint ochre glow of earth qi rises from his bare arms with a few warm motes. Hands and objects: the left thumbnail is completely black, crushed, clearly visible, held up toward the viewer beside the coin; his right hand rests on the long handle of a big hammer, its head on the anvil. Background: a forge dissolving in smoke and mist, rows of hanging tongs, a sheet of dancing sparks from glowing coals. Light: orange forge-light from the lower left, a soft ochre spirit-glow and a rim light on his shoulders. Expression: a friendly, greedy grin with raised brows and a gleam in the eye as he holds out the coin.

people.imagined: He is pumping the bellows in the spring forge, and his whole body is moving with the rhythm. He is asking for nothing. A drop of sweat is on his chin.
people.subject: The moment: at the bellows he leans into a long wooden handle in mid-pump, body swaying in rhythm, eyes on the coals, a bead of sweat at his chin. Face: a plain, humble, gentle face; sunburnt brown; a long soft jaw; mild dark eyes; thin brows heavy with sooty sweat; a short nose; a small calm mouth; smudges of soot on the cheek; ears sticking out a little from the cloth. Hair: black, short, damp, with a sand-gold silk cloth tied round the head. Body: strong, long-armed, lean, bent into the stroke; feet planted wide, the left heel lifted at the top of the stroke. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk: a plain brown robe with a crossed collar lightly embroidered with dunes, sleeves rolled above the elbow, scorched silk wrist wraps, a dark well-worn smith's apron; his sand-gold over-robe hangs on a peg beside him. Power: a thin silvery haze of metal qi flickers at his wrists. Hands and objects: both hands gripping a long bellows handle; behind him a rack of hammers; tongs, a dark water barrel and a rack of unfinished blades in the shadow. Background: a forge with a deep glowing fire in the centre, sparks, rising smoke and mist. Light: strong orange forge glow from the front left, spirit-light motes, a rim light on the damp hair. Expression: a mild, absorbed, humble calm, the steady face of a man who asks for nothing and keeps the rhythm.

people.imagined: In the sheep shed yard, she grins proudly at the viewer with her mouth wide open to show the gap where a ram knocked out her tooth, like a trophy won.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a yard she grins broadly with her mouth wide open, one forefinger pointing at the gap in her upper front teeth. Face (most important: the missing tooth): a freckled, broad, tanned young face; one upper front tooth clearly missing, a dark square gap in an otherwise white row, shown off proudly; bright, bold dark eyes; strong straight brows; a flat nose; a scar on her chin and a small crescent scar from an old ram butt at the right eyebrow; sunburnt cheeks, a cracked bottom lip, a thin sheen of sweat on her nose. Hair: brown, in a short thick braid tied with a strip of red wool, the end splayed, a few loose strands. Body: sturdy, strong shoulders, hands on hips. Clothing: a sand-gold hooded silk robe thrown back over her shoulders, clean, over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars; silk-wrapped vambraces; a sabre on the left hip; a horn whistle. Power: a faint ochre sparkle of earth-qi motes about her. Hands and objects: her right forefinger pointing at her mouth; her left hand on the sabre pommel; a woolly sheep's head just visible behind her. Background: sheep pens and a wooden fence softening into pale mist, a few ewes with ears flicked forward. Light: bright, soft golden light from the upper left, with a gentle glow and rim light on her braid. Expression: a proud, bold, sparkling grin with the chin up, a girl daring the viewer to ask how she lost the tooth.

people.imagined: Writing a letter by the last lamp in the long hall at night, ink on her nails. She hears footsteps and slides the page under the other page, then looks up with an innocent face.
people.subject: The moment: at a small desk by a single lamp, she has just slid a half-written letter under a blank sheet and looks up toward the viewer with a too-innocent expression. Face (most important: ink under the nails): a delicate, oval, pale face; large soft dark eyes; fine arched brows; a straight small nose; a gentle half-smile; cheeks warmed by the lamp and a smudge of ink on her chin; all the fingernails of her right hand are black with ink and held visibly near the page. Hair: black, long, tied up with a ribbon and a silver pin, a few loose locks. Body: slender, upright, a niece's careful posture. Clothing: a finer sand-gold silk robe over a dark-brown silk under-robe with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars in gold thread, wide sleeves with pale silk cuffs, a dark-gold sash with a small jade pendant; a small horn whistle on a thin cord. Power: a few faint ochre motes float above the lamp. Hands and objects: a brush in her right hand with inky fingers; two sheets of plain paper with only faint scribbled lines (no readable text); a small brass lamp. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in dark-brown cord, a plain iron ring guard, a scabbard of sand-coloured canvas over wood smudged with ink, and a few strands of undyed thread tucked into the guard, one stained black. Background: a dim hall of dark rafters and a long row of empty benches fading into mist. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the lower left, a soft moonlit rim light, shadow beyond. Expression: a wide-eyed, over-sweet innocence with the mouth just softened into a smile, a girl caught in the act who is too fickle to feel guilty about it.

people.imagined: Slouched against a wagon wheel on guard, a worn shield strap in his hand, content to be bored. He is checking the strap, which has already snapped twice.
people.subject: The moment: sitting against a wagon wheel in the sun, he holds up a worn leather shield strap and studies its fraying edge with a sleepy half-smile. Face: a broad, round, good-natured young face; sun-brown, nose and cheeks a little peeling; sleepy brown eyes; soft thick brows; a flat nose; a loose easy mouth, a tiny salt crust at its corner and a chapped lower lip; a faint stubble of first whiskers on the chin. Hair: black, short, tousled, a tuft sticking out beneath a faded sand-gold silk cloth tied loosely round his head. Body: big for his age, soft-shouldered, sprawling; belly over his belt, feet stretched out with toes pointing sleepily outward. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk: a clean sand-gold hooded over-robe spread on the ground like a blanket, over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars lightly embroidered with dunes; silk-wrapped vambraces; his salt-cracked bare heels visible, pale. Hands and objects: a round shield faced with dull iron propped beside him; the fraying strap, snapped twice already in his hands; a horn whistle on a cord. Background: a wagon, dozing camels with folded knees, bright pale sand dissolving into hazy mist. Light: bright soft golden noon from the upper left, a band of shadow from the wagon's edge cutting across his legs and leaving the face in warm glowing light, a gentle rim light. Expression: a loose, sleepy, good-natured half-smile with the lids low, a loyal boy content to be bored and hoping never to use the shield.

people.imagined: Riding ahead of the watcher at a caravan stop, shouting a long story over his shoulder, a braid of horsehair at his collar flicking. He has never seen the raiders' faces and he is swearing he has.
people.subject: The moment: on horseback at a caravan stop, he twists in the saddle and shouts toward the viewer with one hand cupped to his mouth, mid-story. Face: a thin, lively, tanned face; shifting hazel eyes; quick arched brows; a long mobile mouth wide open in speech; a small moustache; cheeks red from shouting, a thin line of dust in the creases beside his mouth. Hair: black, short, bound with a red silk headband. Body: wiry, a rider's long legs and short torso, leaning so far over the horse's flank that one boot has almost left the stirrup. Clothing: a sand-gold hooded silk robe whipping behind him, rimmed with pale light, over dark-brown silk with two crossed collars embroidered with dunes and caravan stars; at the collar a thick braid of black horsehair clearly visible; silk-wrapped vambraces; a sabre on the left hip. Power: a faint ochre scatter of earth-qi motes streams behind him in the wind. Hands and objects: a hand cupped to his mouth; the other holds the reins of a brown horse whose mane is partly shown; a horn whistle on a cord. Background: a caravan halt, tents and pale dust blurring into soft golden mist. Light: bright soft sun from the upper left, slanting across the horse's brown coat and putting a pale rim on his cloak. Expression: a wide, shameless grin with bright, wide eyes and a flushed face, shouting happily over his shoulder.

people.imagined: The caravan guard captain in the gorge, holding the line of camels with his sabre drawn, back straight, an old master just before the charge arrives, serene.
people.subject: The moment: in a rocky gorge a veteran guard captain stands with a sabre held ready at his side and glances calmly back over his shoulder toward the viewer; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a long, hard, weathered face; a grey-streaked beard clipped square; steady dark eyes; heavy grey brows with a faint seam of old scar through the left one; a straight nose; a firm mouth; deep lines and fine wrinkles fanning from the outer corners of his eyes. Hair: grey-black, in a tight topknot with a plain iron pin and a few white threads among the grey. Body: tall, lean, upright, spare shoulders. Clothing: he is a mortal, so plainer but clean and graceful: a long hooded travelling robe of sand-gold silk, faded with years, over a dark-brown silk jerkin with two crossed collars, silk-bound vambraces, a plain belt with a horn whistle; no jade, no crown. Hands and objects: a straight sabre in a plain dark sheath at the hip, the right hand on its grip; a coil of rope over his shoulder. Background: faded brown gorge walls and a row of camels in dim, pearly haze, like mist on old silk. Light: soft, pale, moon-like light from the upper left, warm and brown with age, a faint silvery rim. Expression: brave, honest, stubborn; composed. He holds a look of weary calm, as if he already knows what the gorge will cost.
